rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the wheeled board used for skateboarding.

example.english: I used to ride my skateboard around the neighborhood all the time when I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個成日踩住滑板周街滑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 caai2 zyu6 waat6 baan2 zau1 gaai1 waat6
